description_nb: Canonical-first pipeline aligned to original v3.4 12-parent architecture (mode A), with explicit E3 TG2/TG3 summary join, runtime signal normalization and pre-scoring preparation for no-TG HMS handling and duplicate-safe output.

steps.purpose: extract text and preserve page markers
map extracted segments to canonical child nodes using aliases/regex_any with IGNORECASE
identify and parse E3 summary sections for TAKSTMANNENS VURDERING VED TG2 and TAKSTMANNENS VURDERING VED TG3, including point numbers and summary fields
join parsed E3 TG2/TG3 summary content back to the correct canonical child or instance by point number before instance build and scoring

normalize pre-scoring signals from merged point text, including tiltak_present, andre_tiltak_present, concrete_recommended_measure_in_free_text, cost_class_present, cost_interval_present, other_schematic_cost_estimate_present and no-TG HMS tagging
prepare stable point-level keys for duplicate-safe scoring and output by preserving point id, category relation, trigger candidates and remediation candidates before scoring
build instances for parent categories that support instances
run scoring model and existing meta rules on merged base point content plus joined E3 TG2/TG3 summary content and normalized runtime signals
aggregate child findings and instance findings to the 12 parent cards
render public output using canonical parent labels only

critical_rules: Always render exactly 12 parent cards in display_order.
Parent labels must come from canonical points only.
Children must never render as cards.
Instances must render only inside the relevant parent card.
Score on child; roll up to parent.
Lovlighet og sikkerhet must never require TG.
For E3, TAKSTMANNENS VURDERING VED TG2 and TAKSTMANNENS VURDERING VED TG3 must be treated as valid supplementary sources for ARK/ARKAT evaluation.
For E3, TG2/TG3 summary content must be joined back to the correct canonical child or instance by point number before scoring.
For E3, TG3 cost class, interval or other schematic cost indication found on summary pages must follow the linked point into scoring.
Before scoring, runtime must normalize signal fields for tiltak, Andre tiltak, free-text recommended measure and TG3 cost signals.
Before scoring, electrical installation and other no-TG HMS points must be tagged so they are not evaluated as ordinary TG2/TG3 ARKAT points.
Before public output, runtime must preserve stable point-level finding keys so identical findings can be collapsed safely.
